value.rationale: The complete signed run-pair transition spectrum and exact rational weights are natural observables of the Rudin–Shapiro run-length code, not arbitrary small cases. The nine possible transitions give a structural constraint; a length-two run must always be followed by a length-one run, whereas length-one runs have four equally likely successors. The induced nonzero mutual information 1/8+(3/16)log_2 3 quantitatively contrasts with independently distributed nearest-neighbor original signs. These supply a usable all-length structural and information-theoretic benchmark, not a routine restatement of the known maximum run length.
